public_rationale: Contemporaneous Reuters reporting describes an active SEC investigation involving OpenAI and document-preservation requests to its executives. That supports Marcus's narrow statement that the investigation had been revealed by late February 2024. It does not establish that OpenAI or its executives committed misconduct.
limitations: The evidence is reputable news reporting, not a public SEC investigative record.
Reuters attributes the report to the Wall Street Journal; it is not a second independent confirmation.
The precise timing relative to Marcus's previous newsletter was not verified.
